purpose: Remove static propeller disks only, retain approved models for separate Canvas propellers

prompts.sokol:
Use case: precise-object-edit. Edit the supplied APPROVED aircraft sprite for animation preparation. Change ONLY this: REMOVE all propeller blades and their translucent spinning blur disks completely, leaving the painted spinner cones and their hubs intact. Remove the ONE nose propeller disk/blades, keep its colored pointed spinner cone.
The output is the exact same aircraft, framing, camera, fuselage, wings, tail, canopy, markings, color palette and shading. Do not redesign or move the airplane. Preserve its full silhouette except the removed spinning blades. Repair only small formerly occluded aircraft surface if needed. Keep generous margins. Keep ACTUAL transparent alpha background; outside airplane and removed propeller area must be fully transparent, no fog, halos, shadows or scenery. NO propeller blades anywhere, NO blur disk or vertical oval remnants. The aircraft is an approved art asset and its identity must stay unchanged. Separate animated propeller blades will be rendered in Canvas later. No text.
